Summary: Saffron is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for chat support and compliance Q&A over sensitive financial documents. Primary asks: EU data residency, customer-managed KMS (BYOK), full audit logging retained 7+ years, and SOC2/ISO alignment.

Security review status: Completed initial vendor risk intake; they've requested completed SIG Lite + CAIQ export. Saffron's InfoSec emphasised: "we need explicit shared-responsibility matrix — who owns token caching, KV cache purging, and PII redaction at rest/transit". They also want network diagrams showing PrivateLink, VPC peering, and egress controls.

KMS details: Preferred architecture = BYOK with HSM-backed keys (customer KMS in AWS eu-west-1). Questions remain around key escrow and support for key rotation without downtime.

Audit & logging: Must include immutable audit trail for admin actions + model inference logs with redaction pipeline. Retention policy 7 years; they may require log exports to their SIEM (Splunk).

Procurement notes: Legal requested example SLAs for Private tenant (latency, uptime) and indemnity language. Finance asked for ARR banding and overage/burst pricing.

Stated constraints: No outbound data replication to US; all backups must be EU-only. Air-gap option considered for highest-sensitivity workloads but expensive.

Quote from CISO (paraphrased): 'We like Redwood's performance numbers but we cannot compromise on key ownership or residency.'

Next steps (short): 1) return completed SIG/CAIQ v2 by 2026-03-06, 2) deliver KMS integration diagram + BYOK runbook, 3) schedule security deep-dive 2026-03-12.
